ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the vertical axis is labeled "homestead/population change rate," the horizontal axis is "time," and the curves show the evolution of homestead and population change rates in the village at different time stages. P—T is located in the middle-to-late part of the evolutionary process, indicating the stage in which changes in the village population and homesteads continue to develop. Then reason: the background of the question states that, in the process of urban-rural transformation, the rural population undergoes non-agricultural transfer, producing phenomena of "people leaving and houses becoming empty," idle homesteads, and hollowing-out. The change in the population size of the whole village during the P—T stage is related to this continued transfer of population to towns and non-agricultural industries, and its fundamental driving force is the continuous advancement of urbanization.

raw_record.question_text: Read the figure <image1>. During the P—T time period, what is the main reason causing the change in the population size of the whole village?

method.method_draft: 先看图像：图中横轴为时间，纵轴表示宅基地/人口变化率，P—T位于演化过程的中后段。再读题干背景：城乡转型过程中，农村因人口非农业化转移出现“人走屋空”、宅基地闲置和空心化。将P—T阶段的人口数量变化与题干给出的‘人口非农业化转移’相联系，判断其根本动力是城乡转型、城市化不断推进，因此答案为城市化的持续推进。
